name: web-craft-skills
description: A comprehensive skill pack for building, reviewing, launching, and improving websites and web apps.

interface.longDescription: Web Craft Skills is a product-neutral skill pack that bundles 18 focused skills for educational web builds, interface design, motion, brand assets, accessibility, security, SEO, email, performance, analytics, legal/privacy, payments, deployment, AI integration, data resilience, core-flow testing, content quality, and orchestrated launch QA. Four gates ship deterministic zero-dependency scripts.
